title: A claim with room in it

ask.text: Write the stretch it admits.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
The detent sits on one side of the mark. Read which side is permitted.
The mark is at 1, and the arch is lit on one side of it only.

worldFraming.text: Set the mark with your hands and the arch lights the whole stretch it will admit.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Set the mark with your hands and the arch lights the whole stretch it will admit.

ask.text: Set a rail whose admitted stretch is x >= 12.

hints.text: A rail, a mark on it, and a detent sitting on one side of the mark.
Set the mark, then feel which side the detent is on.
The arch has to admit x >= 12 and refuse everything else.
